kill_fact: The catalyst survives every liveness attack and is the only pillar that does: NCT06510816 is ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, 659 enrolled, primary completion 31 October 2026, Q4 2026 topline reaffirmed 7 May and 14 July 2026 (the 14 July ASRS release is Phase 2 baseline data, not the pivotal). Live, dated, unfired. The FDA-alignment pillar also verifies. The kill is that the two facts the file uses to carry this at conviction 3 rather than refuse it are both FALSE against primary sources. (1) THE FORCING FUNCTION IS NOT WHAT THE FILE SAYS. The dossier asserts four times that the primary 'reads at 12 months, so the last patient's final visit has already passed - the data exist or are being cleaned and unblinded right now', and elevates this to an INDEPENDENT corroboration of the guide ('the timing arithmetic independently corroborates the company's guide rather than merely repeating it'). Annexon's own 7 May 2026 release: the primary endpoint is 15-letter BCVA loss at two consecutive visits 'measured at MONTH 15'. Registry primary completion: 31 OCTOBER 2026. Enrollment closed July 2025 + 15 months = LPLV ~Oct 2026. As of 17 July 2026 THE DATA DO NOT EXIST - the last patients are ~3.5 months from their final primary visit. Q4 2026 leaves ~8 weeks from primary completion for lock, unmask and analysis of a 659-patient global double-masked trial: feasible and routinely done, but the tightest possible reading of the guide, not a mechanically-forced event with cushion. A slip into Q1 2027 - which the file itself lists as a bear-confirming trigger - is a live risk the file waves off on arithmetic that is simply wrong. (2) THE FINANCING GUN IS LOADED AND ALREADY FIRING - and this refutes the file AND the prior skeptic shard. The dossier claims 'No offering, shelf takedown or at-the-market prospectus appears in the company's filings between April and July 2026', 'there is no forced financing before the data', and 'The financing gun has already been fired; it is not still loaded'; it treats 'no forced raise in front of the data' as green flag #3 and as what 'removes the most common way these situations die'. Annexon filed an automatic WKSI shelf (S-3ASR) on 31 MARCH 2026 - one day before the file's chosen window opens - expressly including 'a sales agreement prospectus covering ... up to a maximum aggregate offering price of $150,000,000 of registrant's common stock' with TD Cowen. The Q1 10-Q (7 May 2026) then discloses: 'Subsequent to March 31, 2026 and through the date of issuance of these interim unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, the Company sold 1,305,463 shares of common stock under the 2026 ATM program for net proceeds of approximately $8.1 million.' That is an ATM takedown INSIDE the April-July window the file declares clean. The 2024 ATM separately sold 6,049,762 shares for ~$32.7m net in Q1 2026 (~$66.7m cumulative). ~$142m of ATM headroom remains live at management's sole discretion with no pre-announcement. The file lists 'a raise before the data' as an event that CONFIRMS THE BEAR CASE - it has already happened and is ongoing. Note the ATM is disclosed in the 10-Q, not the earnings release, which is why both the dossier and the prior 16 July shard ('no ATM or equity programme disclosed') missed it. (3) THE SPREAD IS GONE ON THE FILE'S OWN MATH: at $5.89 (-9.4%, 7.71m shares vs ~2.9m avg) the market implies ~41% odds against $11.50/$2.00, versus a defensible 35-40% for a post-hoc functional endpoint replicating in a first-of-its-kind Phase 3 whose Phase 2 missed its pre-specified primary; the file's own $5.61 fair value sits BELOW the live price. What remains is a fairly-priced coin flip on a guide tighter than described, with a live $150m ATM dribbling stock into the run-up.
corrections: MATERIAL. The file's conclusion (watchlist, no asymmetry at $5.89) is right; two load-bearing facts supporting it are wrong and must not be carried forward. NOTE ON LINEAGE: this dossier has already absorbed the prior 16 July shard's two big corrections - readout cash is now stated as ~$100-135m ($0.52-0.70/sh) rather than $180-190m, and enrollment is now correctly July 2025 rather than January 2026. Those are fixed and are not re-raised. What survived the rewrite, plus what is new: (1) PRIMARY ENDPOINT IS MEASURED AT MONTH 15, NOT MONTH 12 - the prior shard flagged this and the rewrite did not take it. Strike every instance of 'the primary endpoint reads at 12 months', 'last-patient-last-visit has already passed', 'the data exist or are being cleaned and unblinded right now', and 'the timing arithmetic independently corroborates the company's guide'. Correct: July 2025 close + month 15 = LPLV ~Oct 2026; registry primary completion 31 October 2026; ~8-9 weeks of slack to year-end. The Q4 2026 guide HOLDS, but by the narrowest margin and on management's execution, not on arithmetic that forces it. The file's own test ('a January-2026 enrollment close would read out in early 2027, which would make the Q4 2026 guide impossible') is the right test applied to the wrong duration - at month 15 the July-2025 close only just clears. (2) NEW - A LIVE $150,000,000 ATM EXISTS AND IS BEING DRAWN. Strike 'No offering, 424B5, or ATM prospectus appears in EDGAR between April and July 2026', 'no offering, shelf takedown or at-the-market prospectus appears in the company's filings between April and July 2026', 'There is no forced raise in front of the data', and 'The financing gun has already been fired; it is not still loaded.' Replace: Annexon is a serial ATM issuer with an unlimited automatic WKSI shelf (S-3ASR, 31 March 2026); 2024 program ~$66.7m drawn; 2026 program $150m authorised with TD Cowen, ~$8.1m drawn between 1 April and 7 May 2026, ~$142m live. The 'opportunistic raise into strength' the file lists as a FUTURE risk is a PRESENT fact. (3) ENROLLMENT IS 659, not 'roughly 630' (7 May 2026 release; NCT06510816). (4) SHARE COUNT: pre-funded warrants were 35,765,799 at 31 March 2026 against 162m common, so fully-diluted is ~198m (plus 6,877,622 common warrants), not 194.2m - the file used weighted-average diluted as a proxy for fully-diluted. Cash per share at readout is therefore modestly LOWER than the quoted $0.52-0.70. FMP's $704.4m market cap implies ~120m shares and is refuted; true cap is ~$1.17b. The file was right to discard that aggregator. (5) DIRECTIONAL NOTE, NOT A CORRECTION: ATM issuance at $5-6 against a ~$2 failure value is per-share ACCRETIVE to the cash floor, so the ATM does not break the $2.00 floor downward. It caps the win case, reveals management's own preference to sell into the pre-readout run, and destroys the 'financed through the event, no dilution in front of the data' framing the green flags rest on. The $2.00 remains what the prior shard called it - a forecast of where a failure prints, not a backstop: no deal-break price, no tender, no CVR, no cash-recovery claim, and ~$1.30-1.50 of it rests on crediting tanruprubart on the day the shared C1q mechanism fails. (6) US BLA: the file reads the unfiled tanruprubart BLA as drift ('quietly behind'). The 7 May 2026 release states the submission is 'with initial U.S./European data from FORWARD trial anticipated in 2026' - contingent on FORWARD data, not late. A different and arguably worse risk, since FORWARD is exactly what must establish extrapolation to Western patients. (7) CONFIRMED AND UNCHANGED: catalyst live and unfired; Q4 2026 reaffirmed 7 May and 14 July 2026; $225.0m cash at 31 March 2026, zero debt, runway into 2H 2027 - the company does reach its own catalyst unforced; global FDA/EMA registration path established; PRIME (EMA) and Fast Track (FDA) for GA; EU MAA for tanruprubart under review; price $5.89, 52-week $2.03-$7.18, 50-day $5.39, 200-day $5.00.
evidence: Annexon 8-K exhibit 99.1, 'Annexon Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Portfolio Progress and Key Anticipated Milestones', filed 7 May 2026 (SEC accession 0001193125-26-211863 - PRIMARY): 'ARCHER II is an ongoing global, pivotal, Phase 3 sham-controlled, double-masked trial of vonaprument in 659 patients with GA... Also: 'Topline Phase 3 ARCHER II trial data expected in fourth quarter of 2026'; '$225 million as of March 31, 2026, and Anticipated Runway into Second Half 2027'; 'BLA submission with U.S./European FORWARD data expected in 2026'. Annexon Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 March 2026, filed 7 May 2026 (SEC accession 0001193125-26-211931 - PRIMARY), Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements, 'At the Market (ATM) Program': 'In March 2026, the Company entered into a sales agreement with TD Securities (USA) LLC, or TD Cowen, as sales agent, pursuant to which the Company may offer and sell ... up to $150.0 million, or the 2026 ATM program... Subsequent to March 31, 2026 and through the date of issuance of these interim unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, the Company sold 1,305,463 shares of common stock under the 2026 ATM program for net proceeds of approximately $8.1 million, after deducting commissions paid to TD Cowen.' Same note: under the 2024 ATM program the Company 'sold 6,049,762 shares of its common stock ... for net proceeds of approximately $32.7 million' during Q1 2026 (~$66.7m cumulative as of the 10-Q date). Balance sheet detail: pre-funded warrants 35,765,799 and common warrants 6,877,622 outstanding at 31 March 2026. Proves an ATM takedown INSIDE the April-July 2026 window the file declares clean, ~$142m of live undrawn ATM capacity, and a fully-diluted count of ~198m.
